1. Pad the image with the border mode.
2. Take the natural logarithm of every value above 0, and mark the zeros.
3. Sum the logarithms and the zero marks over each window with running sums.
4. Write 0 where a window holds a 0, and the exponential of the mean logarithm elsewhere.
